translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong heard of this and sent an envoy to rebuke him sharply: "You began as a household servant, rising from humble origins.

sentences.zh: 受國厚恩，累曆重任，乃以私憾，不餞詔使。

translations.literal: You have received deep grace from the state and passed through heavy responsibilities again and again, yet for private resentment you did not see off the imperial envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The state has showered you with favors and entrusted you with high office again and again, yet you let personal spite keep you from seeing off an imperial envoy.

sentences.zh: 當內省自訟，後勿複爾。

translations.literal: You ought to examine yourself within and reproach yourself; hereafter do not again act thus.
translations.idiomatic: Examine your conscience and do not let this happen again.

sentences.zh: 朕不能再三曲恕汝也。」

translations.literal: We cannot repeatedly bend to pardon you.
translations.idiomatic: We cannot keep bending the rules to forgive you."

sentences.zh: 既而思敬為平章政事，東北路招討使鈔兀以私取諸部進馬，事覺被逮，將赴京師。

translations.literal: Later Sijing became Associate Grand Councillor; Chaowu, as Pacification Commissioner of the Northeast Route, privately took tribute horses from various departments—the matter was discovered, he was arrested, and was about to be taken to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Later, after Sijing became Associate Grand Councillor, Chaowu—as Pacification Commissioner of the Northeast Route—was found to have privately seized tribute horses from various tribes. He was arrested and was being taken to the capital.

sentences.zh: 鈔兀為人尚氣，次海濱縣，慨然曰：「吾豈能為思敬辱哉！」

translations.literal: Chaowu was a man who prized his honor; stopping at Haibin County he sighed and said: "How can I suffer disgrace at Sijing's hands!
translations.idiomatic: Proud and high-spirited, Chaowu paused at Haibin County and declared: "I will not be shamed before Sijing!

sentences.zh: 遂縊而死。

translations.literal: He then hanged himself and died.
translations.idiomatic: With that he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 十九年，詔以鈔兀舊功，授其子和尚世襲布輝猛安徒胡眼謀克。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year an edict, in view of Chaowu's former merit, granted his son Heshang hereditary Buhui Meng'an Tuhuyan Mouke.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Dading, an edict citing Chaowu's past service granted his son Heshang the hereditary Buhui Meng'an Tuhuyan mouke.

sentences.zh: 孛朮魯定方

translations.literal: Beipailu Dingfang
translations.idiomatic: Beipailu Dingfang

sentences.zh: 孛朮魯定方，本名阿海，內吉河人也。

translations.literal: Beipailu Dingfang, original name Ahai, was a man of the Neji River.
translations.idiomatic: Beipailu Dingfang, original name Ahai, was from the Neji River region.

sentences.zh: 材勇絕倫。

translations.literal: In talent and courage he was peerless.
translations.idiomatic: His talent and courage were unmatched.

sentences.zh: 海陵素聞其名。

translations.literal: Hailing had long heard his name.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Hailing had long known of him by reputation.

sentences.zh: 天德初，召授武義將軍，充護衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was summoned and granted General of Martial Righteousness, serving as palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Tiande era he was summoned to court, appointed General of Martial Righteousness, and assigned to the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 數月，轉十人長，遷宿直將軍，賜予甚厚。

translations.literal: After several months he was transferred to decarch, promoted to Palace Guard General, and given exceedingly rich rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Within months he was made a decarch, then promoted to Palace Guard General with lavish grants of reward.

sentences.zh: 尋為殿前右衛將軍，又三月，擢殿前右副點檢，世襲猛安，改左副點檢。

translations.literal: Soon he was Right Guard General of the Hall; three months later he was elevated to Right Vice Inspector of the Hall, inherited a meng'an, and was changed to Left Vice Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Right Guard General of the Hall, and three months later was elevated to Right Vice Inspector, inherited a meng'an, and was transferred to Left Vice Inspector.

sentences.zh: 出為河南尹，改彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He went out as Metropolitan Magistrate of Henan and was changed to military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as metropolitan magistrate of Henan, then transferred to military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 海陵南伐，定方為神勇軍都總管。

translations.literal: When Hailing marched south, Dingfang was overall commander of the Shenyong Army.
translations.idiomatic: During Hailing's southern campaign, Dingfang served as overall commander of the Shenyong Army.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，宋人陷汝州，河南統軍使宗尹遣定方將兵四千往取之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading the Song took Ruzhou; Henan Route Commander-in-Chief Zong Yin sent Dingfang to lead four thousand troops to recover it.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading, after Song forces seized Ruzhou, Henan Route Commander Zong Yin dispatched Dingfang with four thousand troops to retake it.

sentences.zh: 汝州東南及北面皆山林險阻，不可以騎軍戰。

translations.literal: Southeast and north of Ruzhou were all wooded mountains, dangerous and obstructed—it was not possible to fight with cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The terrain southeast and north of Ruzhou was mountainous and heavily forested, unsuitable for cavalry engagement.

sentences.zh: 是時，宋兵由鴉路出沒，定方至襄城，得敵虛實，遂牒諭汝州屬縣曰：「我率許州戍兵十二萬徑取汝州，爾等可備糧草二十萬，使人揚言欲據要路絕宋兵往來。」

translations.literal: At that time Song troops appeared and vanished along the Crow Road; Dingfang reached Xiangcheng, learned the enemy's situation, and sent a dispatch instructing the subordinate counties of Ruzhou, saying: "I am leading one hundred twenty thousand garrison troops from Xuzhou to march straight on Ruzhou; you should prepare two hundred thousand [units] of provisions and fodder and have men declare publicly that we intend to seize the key routes and cut off Song troop movements.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces were raiding along the Crow Road. Dingfang reached Xiangcheng, assessed the enemy's strength, and sent dispatches to Ruzhou's subordinate counties: "I am marching on Ruzhou at the head of one hundred twenty thousand troops from Xuzhou's garrison. Prepare two hundred thousand units of grain and fodder, and spread word that we intend to seize the key passes and cut Song communications.

sentences.zh: 既而定方引兵趨鴉路，宋人聞之，果棄城遁去。

translations.literal: Thereupon Dingfang led troops toward the Crow Road; the Song heard this and indeed abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Dingfang then marched toward the Crow Road; hearing this, the Song garrison abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 定方至魯山境，知宋兵已去，遂遣輕騎二百追至布褲叉，擊敗之，遂複汝州。

translations.literal: Dingfang reached the border of Lushan, learned the Song troops had already gone, then sent two hundred light cavalry in pursuit to Bukucha, defeated them, and thus recovered Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the Lushan border and learning the Song had already withdrawn, Dingfang sent two hundred light cavalry in pursuit to Bukucha, routed them, and recovered Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 授鳳翔尹。

translations.literal: He was appointed metropolitan magistrate of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed metropolitan magistrate of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 宋人阻邊，以本職行河南道軍馬副統，率步騎六萬，將由壽州進軍，次亳州。

translations.literal: The Song blocked the border; with his original office he served as deputy commander of Henan Route infantry and cavalry, leading sixty thousand foot and horse, intending to advance from Shou Prefecture, and halted at Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Song forces harassed the frontier, Dingfang served in his existing post as deputy commander of Henan Route forces, leading sixty thousand infantry and cavalry toward Shou Prefecture, halting at Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 宋李世輔陷宿州，定方從左副元帥志甯戰於城下。

translations.literal: Song's Li Shifu took Suzhou; Dingfang followed Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhining in battle beneath the walls.
translations.idiomatic: After Song general Li Shifu seized Suzhou, Dingfang fought beneath the city walls alongside Left Vice Commander Zhining.

sentences.zh: 時天大暑，定方督戰，馳突敵陣中，出入數四，渴甚，因出陣下馬取水，為人所害，年四十四。

translations.literal: The weather was fiercely hot; Dingfang urged the battle on, charging in and out of the enemy formation four or five times; desperately thirsty, he left the formation and dismounted to take water, and was killed by someone; he was forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the blistering heat Dingfang drove his men hard, charging in and out of the enemy lines four or five times. Parched with thirst, he left the formation to drink—and was killed. He was forty-four.

sentences.zh: 上聞而閔之，詔有司致祭，賻銀五百兩、重彩二十端，贈金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: The emperor heard and grieved; he ordered the officials to perform sacrifices, granted five hundred taels of silver and twenty bolts of heavy silk as funeral gifts, and posthumously conferred Gold-Purple-Green Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor grieved at the news, ordered official sacrifices, granted five hundred taels of silver and twenty bolts of fine silk as funeral gifts, and posthumously conferred upon him the title Gold-Purple-Green Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 夾谷胡剌

translations.literal: Jia Guhula
translations.idiomatic: Jia Guhula

sentences.zh: 夾谷胡剌，上京宋葛屯猛安人。

translations.literal: Jia Guhula was a man of the Songgetun meng'an of the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Guhula was from the Songgetun meng'an of the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 初在左副元帥撻懶帳下，有戰功，授武德將軍，襲其父謀克。

translations.literal: At first he was under Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Talan; he had battle merit and was granted General of Martial Virtue and inherited his father's mouke.
translations.idiomatic: He first served under Left Vice Commander Talan, distinguished himself in battle, was appointed General of Martial Virtue, and inherited his father's mouke.

sentences.zh: 正隆末，山東盜起，胡剌為行軍猛安討賊，遇賊千五百人于徐州南，敗之。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenglong bandits rose in Shandong; Hula served as campaigning meng'an to suppress bandits, encountered fifteen hundred bandits south of Xuzhou, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenglong, banditry erupted in Shandong. Hula served as campaigning meng'an against the rebels, encountered fifteen hundred bandits south of Xuzhou, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 山東路統軍司選諸軍八百人作十謀克，胡剌將之，與驍騎軍皆隸點檢司。

translations.literal: The Shandong Route Commander's office selected eight hundred troops from various armies to form ten mouke; Hula commanded them, and together with the crack cavalry army they all came under the Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong Route headquarters selected eight hundred men from various units to form ten mouke companies under Hula's command; he and the crack cavalry were placed under the Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 行至淮南，海陵遣以騎兵三百二十往揚州，敗宋兵千五百人於宣化鎮。

translations.literal: When they reached Huainan, Hailing sent three hundred twenty cavalry to Yangzhou; they defeated fifteen hundred Song troops at Xuanhua Town.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Huainan, Hailing dispatched three hundred twenty cavalry to Yangzhou; they defeated fifteen hundred Song troops at Xuanhua Town.

sentences.zh: 僕散忠義伐宋，胡剌領萬戶由泗州進戰，遇敵於宿州，歿於陣，贈鎮國上將軍。

translations.literal: Pusan Zhongyi campaigned against Song; Hula led a wanhu force advancing from Sizhou into battle, met the enemy at Suzhou, died in the formation, and was posthumously granted General Who Pacifies the State.
translations.idiomatic: During Pusan Zhongyi's campaign against Song, Hula led a wanhu unit from Sizhou into battle, encountered the enemy at Suzhou, and fell on the field. He was posthumously granted the title General Who Pacifies the State.

sentences.zh: 蒲察斡論

translations.literal: Pu Chawolun
translations.idiomatic: Pu Chawolun

sentences.zh: 蒲察斡論，上京益速河人，徙臨潢。

translations.literal: Pu Chawolun was a man of the Yisu River of the Upper Capital and was later moved to Linhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Chawolun was from the Yisu River region of the Upper Capital and was later resettled at Linhuang.

sentences.zh: 祖忽土華，父馬孫，俱贈金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hutuhua and father Masun were both posthumously granted Gold-Purple-Green Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hutuhua and father Masun were both posthumously conferred the title Gold-Purple-Green Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 斡論剛毅有技能。

translations.literal: Wolun was resolute and firm and had military skill.
translations.idiomatic: Wolun was resolute, firm, and skilled in arms.

sentences.zh: 天輔初，以功臣子充護衛，遷左衛將軍、定武軍節度使，召為右副都點檢。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu, as the son of a meritorious official he served as palace guard, was promoted to Left Guard General and military commissioner of the Dingwu Army, and was summoned as Right Vice Chief Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Tianfu era, as the son of a meritorious official he entered the palace guard, rose to Left Guard General and military commissioner of the Dingwu Army, and was recalled as Right Vice Chief Inspector.

sentences.zh: 天德初，授世襲臨潢府路曷呂斜魯猛安，改東平尹，賜錢千萬，累除河南尹。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was granted hereditary Halüxielu meng'an of the Linhuangfu Route, changed to metropolitan magistrate of Dongping with ten million cash granted, and successively removed [from other posts to serve as] metropolitan magistrate of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tiande he was granted the hereditary Halüxielu meng'an of Linhuangfu Route, appointed metropolitan magistrate of Dongping with a grant of ten million cash, and eventually rose to metropolitan magistrate of Henan.

sentences.zh: 海陵伐宋，以本官為右領軍都監。

translations.literal: When Hailing campaigned against Song, with his original office he served as Right Army Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: During Hailing's campaign against Song, he served in his existing post as Right Army Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，仍為河南尹，兼河南路都統軍使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he remained metropolitan magistrate of Henan and concurrently Route Commander-in-Chief of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading he continued as metropolitan magistrate of Henan and concurrently served as Route Commander of Henan.

sentences.zh: 宋以萬人據壽安縣，嵩州刺史石抹突剌、押軍萬戶徒單賽補以騎兵三百巡邏，遇於縣東，請師於斡論。

translations.literal: Song held Shou'an County with ten thousand men; Song Prefecture prefect Shimo Tula and wanhu escort commander Tushan Saibu led three hundred cavalry on patrol, met them east of the county, and requested troops from Wolun.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces occupied Shou'an County with ten thousand men. Songzhou prefect Shimo Tula and escort wanhu Tushan Saibu, patrolling with three hundred cavalry, encountered them east of the county and sent to Wolun for reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 斡論使猛安完顏鶻沙虎率七百人助之。

translations.literal: Wolun had meng'an Wanyan Hushahu lead seven hundred men to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: Wolun dispatched meng'an Wanyan Hushahu with seven hundred men to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 宋兵多，突剌使士卒下馬，跪而射之。

translations.literal: The Song troops were numerous; Tula had the soldiers dismount, kneel, and shoot at them.
translations.idiomatic: Outnumbered by the Song force, Tula ordered his men to dismount, kneel, and shoot.

sentences.zh: 宋兵不能當，走入縣城。

translations.literal: The Song troops could not withstand it and ran into the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Song force could not hold and fled into the county seat.

sentences.zh: 突剌進逼之，宋人棄城去，追及於鐵索口，複大敗之，遂複壽安。

translations.literal: Tula pressed them closely; the Song abandoned the city and left; they were overtaken at Tiesuokou and again suffered a great defeat; Shou'an was thus recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Tula pressed the attack; the Song abandoned the city and fled. He overtook them at Tiesuokou, inflicted another crushing defeat, and recovered Shou'an.

sentences.zh: 改北京留守、大定尹，卒官。

translations.literal: He was changed to Northern Capital Left-Behind Administrator and metropolitan magistrate of Dading, and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Northern Capital Left-Behind Administrator and metropolitan magistrate of Dading, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 夾谷查剌

translations.literal: Jia Guchala
translations.idiomatic: Jia Guchala

sentences.zh: 夾谷查剌，隆州失撒古河人也。

translations.literal: Jia Guchala was a man of the Shisagu River in Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Guchala was from the Shisagu River region of Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖不剌速，國初授世襲曷懶兀主猛安、曷懶路總管。

translations.literal: His grandfather Bulasu, at the founding of the state, was granted hereditary Halüwuzhu meng'an and route commander-in-chief of the Halü Route.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Bulasu, in the founding era of the Jin, was granted the hereditary Halüwuzhu meng'an and appointed commander of the Halü Route.

sentences.zh: 父謝奴，官至工部尚書。

translations.literal: His father Xienu rose to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xienu rose to the post of Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 查剌狀貌魁偉，善女直、契丹書。

translations.literal: Chala was imposing in stature and skilled in Jurchen and Khitan script.
translations.idiomatic: Chala was imposing in bearing and skilled in Jurchen and Khitan script.

sentences.zh: 天德初，以功臣子充護衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he served as guard by virtue of being a meritorious official's son.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiande he served in the guard corps as the son of a meritorious official.

sentences.zh: 二年，授武義將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed General of Martial Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed General of Martial Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢符寶郎，凡再考，出為濼州刺史，改知平定軍事。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Attendant of the Imperial Seals; after two examinations he went out as inspector of Liao Prefecture and was changed to know the Pingding military administration.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to Attendant of the Imperial Seals; after two examinations he was sent out as inspector of Liao Prefecture, then appointed to oversee military affairs at Pingding.

sentences.zh: 海陵南征，為武威軍副都總管。

translations.literal: When Hailing campaigned south, he was deputy metropolitan commander of the Wuwei Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing campaigned south, he served as deputy metropolitan commander of the Wuwei Army.

sentences.zh: 軍還，大定二年，授景州刺史，遷同知京兆尹。

translations.literal: When the army returned, in the second year of Dading he was appointed inspector of Jing Prefecture and transferred to associate metropolitan magistrate of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, in the second year of Dading he was appointed inspector of Jing Prefecture and promoted to associate metropolitan magistrate of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 時彰化軍節度使宗室璋等與宋將吳璘相拒於德順州，元帥左都監徒單合喜遣查剌與諸將議破敵策。

translations.literal: At that time military commissioner of the Zhanghua Army, imperial clansman Zhang, and others were locked in stalemate with the Song general Wu Lin at Deshun Prefecture; Left Army Supervisor of the Commander-in-Chief Tushan Hexi sent Chala with the generals to deliberate on a plan to defeat the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhang, military commissioner of the Zhanghua Army and a member of the imperial clan, was locked in stalemate with the Song general Wu Lin at Deshun Prefecture; Left Army Supervisor Tushan Hexi sent Chala to consult with the generals on how to break the enemy.

sentences.zh: 璋等議曰：「我兵雖屢勝，而敵兵不退者，知我軍少故也。

translations.literal: Zhang and the others deliberated: Though our troops have won repeatedly, the enemy does not withdraw because they know our army is few.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang and the others argued: "Though our troops have won repeatedly, the enemy will not withdraw because they know our forces are few.

sentences.zh: 須都監親至，方可破敵。」

translations.literal: The supervisor must come in person before the enemy can be broken.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisor must come in person before we can defeat them."

sentences.zh: 於是合喜領兵四萬至，遂下德順州。

translations.literal: Hexi thereupon led forty thousand troops there and took Deshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Hexi led forty thousand troops to the scene and captured Deshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入為殿前右衛將軍，襲父猛安，改左衛將軍，遷右副點檢。

translations.literal: He entered court as General of the Right Guard of the Hall, inherited his father's meng'an, was changed to General of the Left Guard, and was transferred to Right Deputy Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as General of the Right Guard of the Hall, inherited his father's meng'an, was transferred to General of the Left Guard, and promoted to Right Deputy Inspector.

sentences.zh: 有疾，丞相良弼視之，謂所親曰：「此人國器也。

translations.literal: When he fell ill, Grand Councillor Liangbi visited him and told those close to him: This man is a vessel of state.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill, Grand Councillor Liangbi visited him and told his intimates: "This man is a pillar of the state.

sentences.zh: 他人有疾，吾未嘗往焉。」

translations.literal: When others have been ill, I have never gone to them.
translations.idiomatic: When others fall ill, I never go to see them."

sentences.zh: 九年，出為東北路招討使兼德昌軍節度使，乃賜金帶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he went out as commissioner for punitive campaigns of the Northeast Route and concurrently military commissioner of the Dechang Army, and was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was sent out as commissioner for punitive campaigns on the Northeast Route and concurrently military commissioner of the Dechang Army, and was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 到官，治有勤績，邊境以安。

translations.literal: On reaching his post he governed with diligent achievement and the border was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On taking office he governed with diligence, and the frontier was pacified.

sentences.zh: 其斷獄公平，道不拾遺。

translations.literal: His adjudication of cases was fair, and things dropped on the road were not picked up.
translations.idiomatic: His judgments were fair, and lost goods were left untouched on the roads.

sentences.zh: 遷臨潢尹兼本路兵馬都總管，蕃部畏服。

translations.literal: He was transferred to metropolitan magistrate of Linhuang and concurrently metropolitan commander of the route's army and horse; the tribal peoples feared and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to metropolitan magistrate of Linhuang and concurrently metropolitan commander of the route's forces; the tribal peoples feared and submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 改西北路招討使。

translations.literal: He was changed to commissioner for punitive campaigns of the Northwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to commissioner for punitive campaigns on the Northwest Route.

sentences.zh: 上遣使宣諭曰：「今諸部初附，命汝撫綏，當使治聲達於朕聽。」

translations.literal: The emperor sent an envoy to proclaim: The various tribes have just submitted; you are ordered to pacify and comfort them—you should let your reputation for governance reach my ears.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent an envoy to instruct him: "The various tribes have only just submitted; you are ordered to pacify and comfort them—let your reputation for good governance reach my ears."

sentences.zh: 大定十二年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the twelfth year of Dading.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year of Dading.

sentences.zh: 查剌性忠實，內明敏，每論大事，超越倫輩。

translations.literal: Chala was loyal and solid by nature, inwardly bright and keen; whenever great affairs were discussed, he surpassed his peers.
translations.idiomatic: Chala was loyal and steadfast by nature, inwardly sharp and perceptive; whenever great affairs were discussed, he surpassed his peers.

sentences.zh: 太師勖嘗曰：「查剌不學而知，方之古人，如此者鮮矣。」

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Xu once said: Chala knows without study; compared with men of antiquity, such as he are rare.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Xu once said: "Chala knows without formal study; among the ancients, men such as he were rare indeed."

sentences.zh: 贊曰：陷泉之捷，震電燁燁。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Victory at Xianquan—thunder and lightning blaze.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: At Xianquan, victory flashed like thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 符離之克，我勢攸赫。

translations.literal: The conquest at Fuli—our might was thereby resplendent.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuli, the conquest made our power resplendent.

sentences.zh: 隴、坻𢶉㩧，淮、濄鉤鈲，成矣。

translations.literal: Long and Di rugged and steep, Huai and Guo with hooked spears—it was accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: On Long and Di, steep and forbidding; on the Huai and Guo, spears like hooked stars—it was accomplished.

sentences.zh: 故列敘諸將之功焉。

translations.literal: Therefore the achievements of the various generals are set forth in order.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the achievements of these generals are recorded here in order.
